problems.questionText:
(本题满分10分)求函数$f(x,y)=\left(2x^{2}-y^{2}\right)e^{x}$ 的极值.

【解析】区$\left\{\begin{aligned}f_{x}^{\prime}&=e^{x}\left(2x^{2}+4x-y^{2}\right)=0\\ f_{y}^{\prime}&=-2ye^{x}=0\end{aligned}\right.$ ，解得：$(x,y)=(0,0),(-2,0)$

$$f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}=e^{x}\left(2x^{2}+8x+4-y^{2}\right),\quad f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}=-2ye^{x},\quad f_{yy}^{\prime\prime}=-2e^{x}$$

(0,0)处:$A_{1}=f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(0,0)=4,B_{1}=f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(0,0)=0,C_{1}=f_{yy}^{\prime\prime}(0,0)=-2$

$A_{1}C_{1}-B_{1}^{2}<0$ ，故$\left(0,0\right)$ 不是$f{\big(}x,y{\big)}$ 的极值点；

$\left(-2,0\right)$ 处：$A_{2}=f_{xx}^{\prime\prime}(-2,0)=-4e^{-2},B_{2}=f_{xy}^{\prime\prime}(-2,0)=0,C_{1}=f_{yy}^{\prime\prime}(-2,0)=-2e^{-2}$ $A_{2}C_{2}-B_{2}^{2}>0,A_{2}<0$ ，故$f(-2,0)=8e^{-2}$ 是$f{\big(}x,y{\big)}$ 的极大值.

problems.questionText: (本题满分12分)若函数$f{\bigl(}u{\bigr)}$ 在区间$\left(0,+\infty\right)$ 内有3阶连续导数，且存在可微函数 $$F(x,y) 使 dF(x,y)=\frac{f(xy)}{x^2y}dx+\frac{f^{\prime\prime}(xy)}{xy^2}dy(xy>0).$$ (1)证明:$\frac{f''(u)}{u}-\frac{f(u)}{u}=C$ ，其中C为任意常数 (2)若$f(1)=1,f^{\prime}(1)=-1,f^{\prime\prime}(1)=0$ ，求函数$f{\bigl(}u{\bigr)}$ 的表达式. 【解析】 (1)记$P(x,y)=\frac{f(xy)}{x^{2}y},Q(x,y)=\frac{f^{\prime\prime}(xy)}{xy^{2}}$ $\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}$ ，得：$\frac{f'''(xy)}{xy}-\frac{f''(xy)}{x^2y^2}-\frac{f'(xy)}{xy}+\frac{f(xy)}{x^2y^2}=0$ 记$u=x y$ ，则$\frac{f^{\prime\prime}(u)}{u}-\frac{f^{\prime\prime}(u)}{u^{2}}-\frac{f^{\prime}(u)}{u}+\frac{f(u)}{u^{2}}=0$ 要证$\frac{f^{\prime\prime}(u)}{u}-\frac{f(u)}{u}=C$ ，即证 $\frac{d}{du}\left[\frac{f^{\prime\prime}(u)}{u}-\frac{f(u)}{u}\right]=\frac{f^{\prime\prime}(u)}{u}-\frac{f^{\prime\prime}(u)}{u^2}-\frac{f^{\prime}(u)}{u}+\frac{f(u)}{u^2}=0$ ,由(1)知命题得证. (2)由(1)知:$f^{\prime\prime}(u)-f(u)=Cu$ ，带入初始条件得：$C=-1$ ，解此二阶常系数线性微分方程得：$f(u)=C_{1}e^{u}+C_{2}e^{-u}+u$ ，带入初始条件得：$C_{1}=-\frac{1}{e},C_{2}=e$ 综上：$f\left(u\right)=-e^{u-1}+e^{1-u}+u$ 扫码下载掌上考研APP—更多考研资讯、考研真题一键获取扫码下载掌上考研APP——更多考研资讯、考研真题一键获取

problems.title: 2026 年数学一 第 19 题
problems.questionText:
(本题满分12分)设有向曲线L为椭圆$x^{2}+3y^{2}=1$ 沿逆时针方向从点$A\left(-\frac{1}{2},-\frac{1}{2}\right)$ 到点$B\left(\frac{1}{2},\frac{1}{2}\right)$ 的部分，计算$\int_{L}\left(e^{x^{2}}\sin x-2xy\right)dx+\left(6x-x^{2}-y\cos^{4}y\right)dy$

【解析】记$L_{1}:y=x$ 从B到A的有向线段，记

$$\begin{aligned}P\left(x,y\right)=e^{x^{2}}\sin x-2xy,Q\left(x,y\right)=6x-x^{2}-y\cos^{4}y,\\  则 I=\oint_{L+L_{1}}Pdx+Qdy-\int_{L_{1}}Pdx+Qdy\end{aligned}$$

由格林公式得：

$$\begin{aligned}&I_{_1}=\oint_{_{L+L_{_1}}}Pdx+Qdy=\iint\limits_{D}\left(\frac{\partial Q}{\partial x}-\frac{\partial P}{\partial y}\right)d\sigma=\iint\limits_{D}6l\ \sigma=6\cdot S_{_D}=6\cdot\frac{1}{2}\cdot\pi\cdot1\cdot\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}=\sqrt{3}\pi.\\ &\\ &I_{_2}=\int_{L_{_1}}Pdx+Qdy=\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(e^{^{x^2}}\sin x-2x^2+6x-x^2-x\cos^4x\right)dx\\ &\\ &=-\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(-3x^2\right)dx=x^3\Big|_{-\frac{1}{2}}^{\frac{1}{2}}=\frac{1}{4}\\ &\\ & 综上:I=I_{_1}-I_{_2}=\sqrt{3}\pi-\frac{1}{4}.\\ \end{aligned}$$

problems.title: 2026 年数学一 第 20 题
problems.questionText:
(本题满分12分）设可导函数$f(x)^{\mathrm{严}}$ 格单调递增，且$\int_{-1}^{1}f(x)dx=0,\quad\int_{0}^{1}f(x)dx$ (1)证明:$a>0$ ;

(2)若$F\left(x\right)=a\left(1-x^{2}\right)+\int_{1}^{x}f\left(t\right)dt$ ，证明存在$\xi\in\left(-1,1\right)$ ，使得$F^{\prime\prime}(\xi)=0$

【证明】

(1)由$f(x) 严$ 格单增，根据几何意义得：$\int_{0}^{1}f(x)dx>\int_{-1}^{0}f(x)dx$

故$2\int_{0}^{1}f\left(x\right)dx>\int_{0}^{1}f\left(x\right)dx+\int_{-1}^{0}f\left(x\right)dx=0$ ，得$2a>0,a>0$ ,得证.

(2)由$F\left(-1\right)=\int_{1}^{-1}f\left(x\right)dx=0,F\left(0\right)=a+\int_{1}^{0}f\left(x\right)dx=0,F\left(1\right)=0\ ,F\left(x\right)=\left\lbrack-1,1\right\rbrack$ 上连续，$\scriptstyle{\big(}-1,1{\big)}$ 内二阶可导，由罗尔定理得：

$\exists\xi_{1}\in(-1,0)$ ,使得$F^{\prime}\left(\xi_{1}\right)=0$ $\exists\xi_{2}\in(0,1)$ ,使得$F^{\prime}(\xi_{2})=0$

$\exists\xi\in\left(\xi_{1},\xi_{2}\right)\subset\left(-1,1\right)$ ,使得$F^{\prime\prime}(\xi)=0$ ，得证.

θ的无偏估计量，并求$D{\left({\hat{\theta}}\right)}$ (2)已知k个失效元件的寿命值分别为$0\leq t_{1}\leq t_{2}\leq\cdots\leq t_{k}$ ，似然函数 $L\left(\theta\right)=\frac{1}{\theta^{k}}e^{-\frac{1}{\theta}\left\lbrack\sum_{i=1}^{k}t_{i}+(n-k)t_{k}\right\rbrack}$ ，求θ的最大似然估计值. 【解析】 (1)设各电子元件使用寿命为$X_{i},i=1,2,\cdots,n$ ，则$T=\min\left\{X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n}\right\}$ ，其中$X_{i}$ 均服从指数分布$E\left({\frac{1}{\theta}}\right)$ T的分布函数为 $$F(t)=P\{T\leq t\}=P\{\min(X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n})\leq t\}=1-P\{\min(X_{1},X_{2},\cdots,X_{n})>t\}考研$$ $$1-\left[P\left(X_{i}>t\right)\right]^{n}=\left\{\begin{aligned}0,&t<0,\\ 1-e^{-\frac{n t}{\theta}},&t\geq0,\end{aligned}\right.$$ 考研van.cn 故T的概率密度为$f(t)=F^{\prime}(t)=\left\{\begin{aligned}&\frac{n}{\theta}e^{-\frac{nt}{\theta}},t>0,\\ &0,t\leq0.\end{aligned}\right.$ $T\sim E\left(\frac{n}{\theta}\right)$ $$E\left(\hat{\theta}\right)=a E\left(T\right)=a\cdot\frac{\theta}{n}=\theta\Rightarrow a=n;$$ $$D\left(\hat{\theta}\right)=a^{2}D\left(T\right)=a^{2}\cdot\frac{\theta^{2}}{n^{2}}=\theta^{2};$$ (2) lr $\ln L\left(\theta\right)=-k\ln\theta-\frac{1}{\theta}\left[\sum_{i=1}^{k}t_{i}+(n-k)t_{k}\right]$ $$\frac{d\ln L\left(\theta\right)}{d\theta}=\frac{-k}{\theta}+\frac{1}{\theta^{2}}\left[\sum_{i=1}^{k}t_{i}+(n-k)t_{k}\right]=0$$ 得$\hat{\theta}=\frac{1}{k}\left[\sum_{i=1}^{k}t_i+(n-k)t_k\right]$ 为θ的最大似然估计值. 扫描二维码，下载掌上考研获取完整版真题和资料
